title: Boundary Regularity for Complete Conformal Metrics
strongest_authored_result: Equivalence on explicit one-sided free Jordan arcs, with a componentwise regular-open sufficient criterion for blow-up implying local completeness.
exact_unresolved_gap: No necessary-and-sufficient or weakest general boundary-set hypothesis; arbitrary Gamma and thin endpoint geometries are not classified.
dependencies: Localized disk completeness comparison stated in OWR 9/2007 p.529
control_scope: Exact curvature, radial antiderivative, cutoff scaling and barrier identities only.
source_limitations: Full KRR 2007 article not available; publisher PDF route returned HTML preview.
